cards.headline: The tape: a mixed, rotational tape, 54% of energy names green
cards.body: SPX -1.64% · WTI +2.04% · Brent -1.08% · NatGas -2.13%. 54% of 67 energy names are green — a mixed, rotational tape. Shale & E&P is doing the heavy lifting at +1.82%.

cards.headline: Shale & E&P leads, Grid, Storage & Electrification lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Shale & E&P at +1.82%; weakest is Grid, Storage & Electrification at -3.91%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: CCJ is the standout at -9.28%
cards.body: Leaders: LNG +2.89%, AR +2.43%, FANG +2.35%, EQNR +2.23%, EQT +2.15%. Laggards: CCJ -9.28%, BE -8.99%, FLNC -7.41%, UUUU -6.68%.
cards.watch: Hot means attention, not direction — watch whether the leaders hold the bid or fade into the next session.
